name: declaration_emit_of_divergent_accessors_be1f8927
subject: Fix declaration emit of divergent accessors in JS classes (#58172)

triage.label: bug
triage.reason: Declaration emit for divergent getter/setter accessors in JS classes used the read type of the property where the setter parameter's write type is needed. Changing getTypeOfSymbol to getWriteTypeOfSymbol corrects the emitted setter parameter type.
